purpose: Verify whether observation_id is globally unique across dataset_id in the exact pinned flattened release, because the v0.2 structural support gate counted distinct observation_id as measurement records.
checks: count distinct dataset_id + observation_id composite keys
count observation_id values associated with more than one distinct dataset_id
maximum number of datasets associated with one observation_id

decision.zero_cross_dataset_collisions: v0.2 record identity is validated; HOLD_AUSTRAITS_TRAIT_SUPPORT remains terminal under the frozen thresholds.
decision.any_cross_dataset_collision: v0.2 support result is technically non-terminal because distinct observation_id may undercount records. Re-run the identical biological gate with (dataset_id, observation_id) as the record key; no threshold, rank, cell, or trait rule may change.
